title: 63.4% of Arkansas is in exceptional drought
lede: Exceptional drought (D4) is the worst of the Drought Monitor's five drought levels.
We show how much of each state's land was at that level on four maps.

big.label: of Arkansas's land area in exceptional drought (D4), map valid Nov 24, 2026

chart.title: Share of each state's land in drought, four Drought Monitor maps
series: Extreme drought or worse (D3 or D4)

facts.text: 63.4% of Arkansas was in exceptional drought (D4) on the Nov 24 map, up from 55.8% a week earlier.
facts.source: U.S. Drought Monitor (National Drought Mitigation Center, USDA, NOAA), map valid Nov 24, 2026

facts.text: It was 37.1% four weeks earlier (Oct 27) and 0% a year earlier (Nov 25, 2025).
facts.source: U.S. Drought Monitor (National Drought Mitigation Center, USDA, NOAA), map valid Nov 24, 2026

facts.text: 86.5% of Arkansas was in extreme drought or worse (D3 or D4), the same as 86.5% a week earlier.
facts.source: U.S. Drought Monitor (National Drought Mitigation Center, USDA, NOAA), map valid Nov 24, 2026

facts.text: 62 of Arkansas's 75 counties had some exceptional drought, up from 60 a week earlier and 48 four weeks earlier.
facts.source: U.S. Drought Monitor (National Drought Mitigation Center, USDA, NOAA), map valid Nov 24, 2026

facts.text: In 47 of those counties, at least half the land was in exceptional drought.
facts.source: U.S. Drought Monitor (National Drought Mitigation Center, USDA, NOAA), map valid Nov 24, 2026

facts.text: Louisiana: 22.3% in exceptional drought, 66.5% in D3 or worse. Mississippi: 27.8% in exceptional drought, 66.9% in D3 or worse.
facts.source: U.S. Drought Monitor (National Drought Mitigation Center, USDA, NOAA), map valid Nov 24, 2026
